tasks.subject: Task 0: Snapshot fresh benchmark numbers
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Run all four examples/*.py scripts in a clean state and capture printed numbers as source-of-truth for article citations.

**Files:**
- Create: docs/plans/articles/benchmarks-snapshot.md

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- All 4 example scripts run cleanly; outputs captured verbatim
- Snapshot file includes timestamp, machine spec, Python/numba/numbox/duckdb versions, numbduck commit SHA
- Headline numbers section present
- Committed

**Verify:** test -s docs/plans/articles/benchmarks-snapshot.md && grep -c '^## ' docs/plans/articles/benchmarks-snapshot.md


tasks.description:

**Files:**
- Create: docs/plans/articles/article-1-numba-discourse-reply.md

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- 5 sections per spec
- Word count 800-1200
- Numbers match snapshot exactly
- Team voice (no I/my/Milton/Goykhman)
- Goykhman-only numbduck links
- numba.readthedocs.io/en/stable (not pydata.org)
- UDAF section: one-sentence create_aggregate gap aside + duckdb#5116 link
- No placeholders; closes with invitation

**Verify:** wc -w returns 800-1200; grep -nE 'nelson2005|Milton|TBD|TODO|pydata\.org' returns nothing

tasks.subject: Task 5: Cross-article consistency review
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Read all three drafts as a set; fix consistency issues (voice, numbers, term usage, framing of shared facts).

**Files:**
- Modify (if issues found): any of article-{1,2,3}-*.md

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Numbers consistent across drafts (match snapshot)
- bnmoch3 framing respectful in all three
- UDAF impossible→possible in Articles 2+3; aside in Article 1
- Team voice: grep -nE '\bI\b|\bmy\b' returns empty across all drafts
- Cross-article links correct
- No duplicated language

**Verify:** Manual re-read back-to-back; final voice grep empty

```json:metadata
{"files": ["docs/plans/articles/article-1-numba-discourse-reply.md", "docs/plans/articles/article-2-duckdb-news.md", "docs/plans/articles/article-3-hn-essay.md"], "verifyCommand": "grep -cnE '\\bI\\b|\\bmy\\b|\\bme\\b' /home/erik/projects/numbduck/docs/plans/articles/article-*.md || echo voice_clean", "acceptanceCriteria": ["numbers consistent", "bnmoch3 respectful", "UDAF framing per spec", "team voice", "no duplicates"], "model": "opus", "effort": "max"}
```
